design.summary: Repair the outer loop in five behavioral slices plus one integration slice. First make evidence and review authority explicit. Then make route edges carry typed outputs into dependent inputs. Then extract node execution into a bounded scheduler that runs only dependency-ready read-only groups concurrently. Then keep remediation in the same parent context and centralize truthful child-status aggregation. Finally synchronize payloads, expand regression coverage, and run all gates.
boundaries: csm-orchestrate owns parent requirements, route state, receipts, and review dispatch metadata.
Sibling skills own produced artifacts and internal lifecycle semantics.
The host owns execution, reviewer separation, approval authenticity, and durable storage implementation.
Tests may inject a synthetic host, reviewer, resolver, and cursor store but must label them as test seams.
dataFlow: phase acceptance signal -> explicit requirement/claim binding -> current typed evidence
upstream completed output refs -> schema/owner/run/digest compatibility -> dependent node input refs
dependency-ready read-only nodes -> bounded concurrent dispatch -> deterministic ordering and cursor persistence
final review finding -> inserted remediation phase -> same parent ledger/receipt -> repeated gates
